COMMUNITY HELPERS WORKSHEETS · AGES 4–5

Community Helpers & Our Neighborhood worksheets — printables for little hands.

Thirty-five genuine activity sheets about the people who help us: trace their names, match their tools, circle the right things, count, and draw. Download the original sheet, print it, or solve every sheet on screen in Class 33 first.
